name: distill-anything
description: Distill Anything: reverse-engineer any codebase or findings into a grounded, novelty-verified Agent Skill powered by Codex CLI.
author: Mamdouh Aboammar <mamdouh@aboammar.dev>

scripts.build: bun build bin/distill-anything.ts bin/mcp-server.ts --outdir dist --target bun
scripts.install:skill: bun -e "import { cpSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, symlinkSync } from 'node:fs'; import { homedir } from 'node:os'; import { join, resolve } from 'node:path'; const src = resolve('skills/distill-anything'); for (const base of ['.claude/skills', '.agents/skills']) { const dir = join(homedir(), base); const dest = join(dir, 'distill-anything'); const legacy = join(dir, 'repo-to-skill'); mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }); rmSync(legacy, { recursive: true, force: true }); rmSync(dest, { recursive: true, force: true }); try { symlinkSync(src, dest); } catch { cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true }); } console.log('Installed ->', dest); }"
scripts.install:plugin: bun -e "import { cpSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, symlinkSync } from 'node:fs'; import { homedir } from 'node:os'; import { join, resolve } from 'node:path'; const src = resolve('.'); const dir = join(homedir(), '.gemini/config/plugins'); const dest = join(dir, 'distill-anything'); mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }); rmSync(dest, { recursive: true, force: true }); try { symlinkSync(src, dest); } catch { cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true }); } console.log('Installed plugin ->', dest);"
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
